{{HTP}} == Description == '''{{PAGENAME}}''' were introduced upon release to the game alongside with the '''[[Flow|Flows]]''' system. Styles allow the player to utilize a set of skills and abilities to their advantage depending on the Style the player has currently equipped. There are various different types of Styles, ranging from offensive ones to defensive ones. They are also split into '''six''' different unique tiers/rarities, these being {{Rarity|Rare}}, {{Rarity|Epic}}, {{Rarity|Legendary}}, {{Rarity|Mythic}}, {{Rarity|World Class}}, and {{Rarity|Master}}! There are certain times where {{Rarity|Limited}} Styles are released, which are only available for a short period of time before becoming unobtainable. '''Styles''' are based on various notable characters from the manga/anime series, [https://bluelock.fandom.com/wiki/Blue_Lock_Wiki'''Blue Lock'''], as that is the media Blue Lock: Rivals is based off of. == Obtainment == {| class="wikitable" style="width:100%; text-align:left;" ! Method !! Details |- | '''Purchasing with {{Yen|Amount=2500}}''' || The most common method. Costs {{Yen|Amount=2500}} per spin. |- | '''Completing [[Quests]]''' || Most quests reward cash to purchase spins, while some may directly give {{Spins|Style}} or {{Spins|StyleLucky}} after finishing 8 quests via the reward bar. |- | '''Daily Rewards''' || Daily login rewards include Style Spins. |- | '''Robux / Free Rewards''' || {{Spins|StyleLucky}} can be purchased with [https://roblox.fandom.com/wiki/Robux Robux] (starting at 199), or obtained for free via '''[[Codes]]''' or '''[[Quests]]'''. |- |'''Weekly Codes''' |Every Saturday there's an update that includes codes that can give you {{Spins|StyleLucky}} |- |'''Admin Abuse''' |Every Wednesday and Saturday there's admin abuse where they give away more than 40 {{Spins|StyleLucky}} |} == Spin Odds ==
